answer: The river schedule is applied in oasis and nectar exposes each instalment. An copycat therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2510 identities would post 2947 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
